title: Add bounded native DPMI AX=0100 DOS-memory allocation
description: Python/Unicorn now models measured DPMI AX=0100, but the native C gw_dos_services callback still traps it. Add an explicitly configured conventional-memory paragraph arena and selector allocator to the native callback; AX=0100 must return AX real-mode segment and DX registered selector, back only configured ranges below 0xA000, and return DOS error 8/BX largest block or DPMI 8011 on descriptor exhaustion. Add a 32-bit C harness covering success registers, descriptor base/range, invalid zero size, unconfigured/exhausted arenas and protected-memory exclusion. Do not choose default arena bounds without WORK1-021 evidence.
acceptance: Native C callback handles INT 31h AX=0100 only after explicit safe arena configuration
Success registers match DPMI: AX=segment, DX=selector, CF=0
The selector resolves to the allocated linear base and exact paragraph limit
No configured arena can overlap VGA/ROM memory at or above segment A000
The 32-bit native harness passes invalid, unavailable and descriptor-limit cases
